mapper.sql: n.*, e.equip_name, (SELECT r.row_no FROM prod_check_row r WHERE r.row_id = n.check_row_id) AS sheet_row_no
mapper.select: SELECT FROM quality_nonconform n LEFT JOIN base_equipment e ON e.equip_code = n.equip_code WHERE n.nc_id = #{ncId}
SELECT IFNULL(MAX(CAST(SUBSTRING(nc_no, LENGTH(#{prefix}) + 1) AS UNSIGNED)), 0) FROM quality_nonconform WHERE nc_no LIKE CONCAT(#{prefix}, '%')
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO quality_nonconform (nc_no, occur_date, equip_code, part_no, product_name, lot_no, defect_code, defect_name, qty, unit, status, disposition, action_note, source, check_row_id, remark, reg_user_id, reg_user_name, upd_user_id, upd_user_name) VALUES (#{ncNo}, #{occurDate}, #{equipCode}, #{partNo}, #{productName}, #{lotNo}, #{defectCode}, #{defectName}, #{qty}, #{unit}, #{status}, #{disposition}, #{actionNote}, #{source}, #{checkRowId}, #{remark}, #{regUserId}, #{regUserName}, #{regUserId}, #{regUserName})
INSERT INTO quality_defect_type (defect_code, defect_name, sort_order, use_yn) VALUES (#{defectCode}, #{defectName}, #{sortOrder}, #{useYn})
mapper.update: UPDATE quality_defect_type SET defect_name = #{defectName}, sort_order = #{sortOrder}, use_yn = #{useYn} WHERE defect_id = #{defectId}
